title: Detecting Offensive Memes with Social Biases in Singapore Context Using Multimodal Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for religion alone. The overall findings indicate that Vision-Language Models, when fine-tuned on a localized dataset that includes memes mocking religious beliefs, show significantly improved performance in detecting offensive content relevant to the Singaporean context.
